name: InvenTree BoM Checker
description: Check stock, match parts with local AI, create Mouser carts and prepare InvenTree builds inside KiCad.
description_full: Native KiCad 9/10 stock checking, unified Settings, encrypted credentials, OpenAI-compatible and native Ollama endpoints. Review AI matches and exclusions, create Mouser carts from verified search candidates without ordering, and create InvenTree builds with exact PCB-lot allocation. KiCad 11 is not supported by this SWIG package.
